failures.cause: The frozen builder correctly requires a new output directory. The first Make integration reused an existing local build after Makefile changed.
failures.fix: Use a fresh mktemp subdirectory, then copy successfully verified outputs into the public build directory. No frozen builder, source, oracle, or assertion changed.

failures.cause: The first Make recipe invoked frozen host test scripts with -I, which removes their script directory from imports and hid the checked sibling client module.
failures.fix: Run the unchanged host qualification scripts with -B as documented by the frozen package. Build and report binder retain isolated execution; all frozen package and reference files are still hash checked.
